corrections.text: The article's Background section states Java's 26-percentage-point gap puts it below 'the next-lowest language, C#.' Veracode's Java-focused post actually measures that 26-point gap against JavaScript (56.99% vs. Java's 31.00%, a 25.99-point difference), not C# (59.55%, a 28.55-point gap). The next-lowest language above Java is JavaScript, not C#.

The article's Current situation section states the 4-point large/medium/small model-size pass-rate spread (55%/52%/51%) 'has grown from one percentage point to four since October 2025.' Veracode's Fall 2026 post does not attribute that 1-point figure to the model-size comparison or to October 2025; it describes model size as having had 'essentially no effect' as of October 2025. The '1 percentage point growing to 3' figure in the source instead describes a separate comparison -- general-purpose models vs. coding-specialized models -- measured from July to October 2026.
